title: DecipherCon 2000 Kessling's Report P1

summary: Michael Kessling's DecipherCon 2000 report, part 1, was posted off-site at www.angelfire.com/ga3/TREPORT; the Decktech post is only a pointer to it.
notes: Body is only a pointer: "I posted it there to avoid being censored". The Angelfire report text is not available, so no games, decks or results are recorded.
Author signs "Mike Kessling" (handle Troop1023); person page is Mike Kessling (Michael Kessling is a redirect), so author_link = Mike Kessling.
Hub: Kessling took Michael Riboulet's Day 2 seat as the Naboo Regional runner-up and finished 54th on Day 2, 4 (−57) — not stated in this post, so author_finish left null.
